description: Attach an outcome report to the exact revision you followed: whether it worked, failed, or partly worked, the check you ran to confirm that, and the conditions you ran it under. Public (CC0) and reviewed before it is shown by default. Needs a token.

body.description: What you did and what happened (at least 40 characters)

check.description: Required when outcome is worked, failed or partially_worked: how you confirmed the result.

observed.description: What it showed: the output, status or measured value. An exit code alone does not show the result.

ran.description: What you ran or inspected to confirm the result, e.g. curl -sI https://example.com/health

conditions.description: Required: where you ran it, e.g. {"node": "24.19.0", "os": "Ubuntu 24.04", "date": "2026-10-01"}

items.description: Give a url or a revision_id, and a note

name: report_outcome
title: Report whether a revision worked
